verdict: Paid social is profitable this period, but funnel leaks and weak local review velocity are capping growth.
diagnosis: Ad spend of $2,167 drove $11,972 in purchases — strong returns, but only 562 sales from 2,681 clicks means the funnel leaks after the click.

signals.headline: $11,972 in sales from $2,167 spend
signals.detail: The Muslim Subscription Box campaign is producing roughly $5.50 back for every $1 spent this period — well above the healthy 3-to-1 band.

signals.headline: 562 purchases, only 237 add-to-carts
signals.detail: The action counts don't line up cleanly, suggesting tracking or attribution overlap. Worth auditing the pixel setup before scaling spend.

signals.headline: 2,681 clicks generated 1,660 landing views
signals.detail: About 38% of clicks never load the landing page. Page speed or a broken redirect is likely wasting roughly $820 of this period's spend.

signals.headline: Instagram followers grew by 106
signals.detail: Organic growth is modest against 6,654 total followers. Media engagement of 679 shows the audience reacts but rarely follows.

signals.headline: 272 Google reviews averaging 5 stars
signals.detail: Local reputation is a real asset. Only 2 new reviews landed this period — a bigger ask cadence could compound this advantage.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Food and beverage brands convert higher than average
benchmark.body: Food and beverage direct-to-consumer stores typically convert visitors to buyers at 4.5%–6.0%, well above the 1.7%–2.5% global ecommerce average. Paid social traffic usually converts under 1%.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: The global meat subscription market is projected to grow from $1.7B in 2024 to $7.1B by 2034. Late summer is a strong window for grilling and religious-occasion boxes.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: ButcherBox and subscription players dominate mindshare
competitor.body: ButcherBox leads on ethics and animal welfare messaging. Meal-kit and subscription meat brands are spending heavily on acquisition — HelloFresh sits at 21.8% of revenue on marketing to fight churn.

recommendations.title: Test creative variants for the Muslim Subscription Box
recommendations.detail: The awareness ad drove 562 purchases at $2,167 spend. Consider testing 2–3 new creative angles (recipes, family occasions, halal sourcing) to lower cost per purchase further.

recommendations.title: Fix the click-to-purchase drop
recommendations.detail: Only 237 add-to-carts came from 2,681 clicks. Worth reviewing the landing page, price presentation, and checkout speed on mobile to close the gap.

recommendations.title: Ask recent buyers for Google reviews
recommendations.detail: The profile added 2 reviews this period at a 5-star average. Consider a post-purchase email or SMS asking for a review to build local trust.
